items.title: David Torkanowsky interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019
items.q: I didn’t know any of this at the time... Chuck Berry wants to use Johnny Johnson you know, because he thought you know, you stole his thunder

ctx.x: Johnny Johnson, thank you. The great Sun records session player. He wanted him to come along as kind of an M.D. And George Wein, who just had to wire $400,000 into Chuck Berry’s account ahead of the tour, because that was part of the deal, said absolutely not. If you want Johnny Johnson to come you’ve got to pay for him. I didn’t know any of this at the time. So we had one gig at Penn’s Landing in Philadelphia as a warm-up for this entire European tour and Chuck Berry was great. So we’re here, the © Fillius Jazz…
place is packed. Outdoor arena right on the river, beautiful, like an amphitheater. The place is packed. Nobody has seen Chuck Berry.
